9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:f0f9ca48-6ac5.title: Electronics & Hardware Buyer/Purchaser
9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:f0f9ca48-6ac5.description: Location: Onsite — Austin, TX Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full Time Job Title: Buyer/Purchaser About 9 Mothers The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. Why 9 Mothers? While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. Position Summary 9 Mothers builds counter-UAS systems — robotic shotgun turret platforms and a proprietary belt-fed shotgun system. Everything we ship starts with parts: custom electronics, machined metal, actuators, cables, and cameras, sourced from vendors we trust. Today, engineers buy their own parts. That stops working the moment we move from prototype and small-run quantities into production — which is exactly where we are headed over the next 12 months. You will be our first dedicated buyer and, initially, a department of one. You will own procurement end to end: finding parts, qualifying vendors, negotiating, placing and chasing POs, and building the purchasing processes and systems this company will scale on. As we grow into production, this role grows with the company — the person who defines purchasing here has a clear path to leading the function. Two things make this role harder than a typical buyer seat. First, we run on scarce, allocated electronics — NVIDIA Jetson modules, cameras, specialty sensors — and you need to be the person who can find them when distributors say twelve months. Second, we are a defense company: our supply base must exclude Chinese vendors, with a strong preference for US suppliers, and you own keeping it that way. Essential Duties Sourcing & Procurement (Primary) - Source and purchase the full robotics bill of materials: custom electronics and PCB assemblies, CNC-machined metal parts, actuators and motors, cable assemblies, cameras and sensors, and supporting COTS hardware - Hunt down hard-to-find and allocated electronics — NVIDIA Jetson modules, GPUs, image sensors — through authorized distribution, direct manufacturer relationships, and carefully vetted secondary-market channels, managing counterfeit risk and allocation constraints - Run the quote-to-PO cycle: solicit and compare quotes, negotiate pricing, payment terms, and lead times, place purchase orders, and track and expedite deliveries against build schedules - Own vendor selection within our trade-compliance constraints: build and maintain a non-Chinese supply base with a strong preference for US vendors, verifying country of origin down to the component level where required Building the Purchasing Function - Define the company's purchasing processes from scratch: PO workflow and approvals, vendor onboarding and qualification, receiving and inspection handoff, and spend tracking - Select and stand up purchasing tooling — from spreadsheets that actually work today to an ERP/MRP system that supports production volumes - Build and maintain the approved vendor list; work with engineering on part numbering, BOM hygiene, and approved alternates - Give the company visibility: report on spend, open orders, lead-time risk, and cost trends so engineering and leadership can plan around reality Scaling to Production - Transition the supply base from prototype and small-run buys to production purchasing: qualify vendors for volume, establish second sources for critical parts, and negotiate volume

assistworld-assist-world:lever:a8db473b-.title: Social Media Manager
assistworld-assist-world:lever:a8db473b-.description: About the Organisation An Australian not-for-profit charity working in Cambodia, focused on teacher training and children's education programs. The organisation is looking to build a consistent, high-quality social media presence to raise awareness, engage donors, and drive fundraising outcomes. Strategy, messaging, content assets, audience briefs, and campaign direction are all provided — what is needed is someone who can take those inputs and execute them with precision across platforms. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Social Media Manager to manage and execute paid and organic social media campaigns across Facebook/Meta, Instagram, and LinkedIn. This is an implementation-focused role — the organisation provides the strategy, assets, copy, and briefs. The right candidate will know their way around Meta Business Suite, understand campaign setup and budget management, and consistently deliver content that is on-time and on-brand. Key Responsibilities Campaign Setup & Execution • Set up and manage paid ad campaigns across Facebook/Meta and Instagram using Meta Business Suite. • Configure targeting, audiences, budgets, and scheduling based on briefs provided by the team. • Manage LinkedIn content publishing and organic engagement. • Ensure campaigns go live on time and run as planned from start to finish. Content Scheduling & Asset Management • Receive content assets (images, videos, copy) from the team and assemble them into a content calendar. • Schedule posts across platforms in line with campaign timelines (week 1, week 3, week 5 messaging cadence, etc.). • Create simple graphic tiles in Canva where needed, using provided brand images and guidelines. Analytics & Reporting • Monitor campaign performance including reach, engagement, cost-per-result, and ROI metrics. • Provide regular performance summaries and flag underperforming content for review. • Make data-informed optimisations to improve results within approved budget parameters. Account Management • Manage access and administration of social accounts (currently operated out of Cambodia; coordination required). • Keep platforms organised, up to date, and compliant with Meta and LinkedIn policies. Requirements Essential • Minimum 3-4 years of experience managing social media for organisations or clients. • Proven hands-on experience running paid campaigns in Meta Business Suite (Facebook & Instagram ads). • Confident reading and interpreting social media analytics — not just vanity metrics. • Proficient in Canva for basic asset creation and resizing. • Strong attention to detail — campaigns must go live correctly, on time, every time. • Portfolio of past social media work required for consideration. Advantageous (Not Required) • Experience managing social media for charities, NGOs, or cause-based organisations. • Familiarity with LinkedIn campaign management and organic content strategy. • Experience working with cross-border or remote teams. Why Join Assist World? 100% REMOTE $50 birthday bonus $200 testimonial bonus $500 entry monthly raffle NO TRACKER. NO PROBLEM

beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:b1.title: Employment Counsel
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:b1.description: Beacon is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software and services companies: niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are too specific for the enterprise giants and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. We seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. Our flexible structure offers entrepreneurs a unique option to implement a transition that ensures the continuity of the company while receiving liquidity at full value for their equity in their business. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are permanent, committed capital with no exit pressure and a long-term time horizon, backed by a diverse base of investors including Wall Street (D1 Capital, CPMG), Silicon Valley (General Catalyst and Lightspeed), the family offices of world-class technology entrepreneurs (including the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp), and evergreen funds built for the long game (Sator Grove). Beacon was founded by Nilam Ganenthiran, entrepreneur, former President of Instacart, and investor at D1 Capital, who has spent his career building, scaling, and backing high-growth technology businesses. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurially-minded employment lawyer to join Beacon’s legal team as our first dedicated employment specialist. This is a foundational role — you will build Beacon’s employment legal function from the ground up, partnering closely with HR to establish the policies, templates, and processes that will underpin how Beacon and its portfolio companies operate as employers. Reporting to Beacon’s VP, Legal, you will serve as the go-to employment law resource across the organization, advising on the full spectrum of employment matters: from day-to-day questions arising across our growing portfolio to managing complex terminations, navigating employment claims and litigation, and building out the scalable infrastructure that a permanent-hold, multi-entity acquirer needs. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for a lawyer who thrives on building, is energized by variety, and wants to own an entire function rather than execute within one. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Employment Function Builder: Own the build-out of Beacon’s employment legal function. This means establishing the infrastructure from scratch: designing the governance model, setting employment law coverage across Beacon and its portfolio, and creating the workflows and escalation protocols that allow the business to operate at scale. You will be the single point of accountability for employment law across the organization and will define what that function looks like. • HR Partnership and Policy Development: Work hand-in-hand with Beacon’s HR team to build the foundational building blocks of the employment relationship — employment agreements, offer letter templates, onboarding and offboarding documentation, HR policies, employee handbooks, and codes of conduct. Ensure all policies and practices are legally compliant, commercially sensible, and scalable across a multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction organization. Partner with HR on sensitive people matters, providing real-time legal guidance that balances risk management with practical business outcomes. • Portfolio Employment Support: Serve as the employment law resource for Beacon’s portfolio of

Our mission is simple: free people from work that slows them down, so they can do the work that matters. Our website and digital design presence are core growth engines. jobgether-jobgether:lever:38bc7d45-b4ad-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Mexico. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

southparkcommons-doppel:ashbyhq:4a6d8843.description: Why Join Doppel Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. What We're Building We're building the AI-native social engineering defense platform. This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. What We're Looking For We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer to build out the infrastructure required to rapidly scale up our engineering organization. A few examples of the work we’ve done recently: - Built a scalable data platform with a robust DBT transformation layer, enabling customers, engineers, and analysts to reliably model and query large-scale event data, track key product metrics, and power customer facing analytics. - Launched a flexible notification system, delivering timely, reliable alerts across Slack, email, and other channels for internal and customer-facing use cases. - Standardized core service patterns and shared business logic (auth, persistence, messaging), scaling them into reusable services that reduce duplication, ensure consistency, and enable product engineers to move faster as the company grows. What We Offer 🚀 A mission-driven culture with low ego, high ownership, deep customer obsession, and exceptional talent density 🍽️ Free lunch and dinner in the office 🌴 Flexible PTO ✈️ Quarterly team offsites JOIN DOPPEL Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.
